entries.name: block.contact.area

entries.description: Get block 1 at a contact. By default the host block is returned for merged blocks. By setting b to true, the faceblock will be returned.

entries.name: block.contact.b2
entries.description: Get block 2 at a contact. By default the host block is returned for merged blocks. By setting b to true, the faceblock will be returned.

entries.name: block.contact.dfnid
entries.description: Get the Discrete Fracture Network (DFN) ID number at a contact.

entries.name: block.contact.energy
entries.description: Get the component of energy named s associated with the contact. Admissible values for s depend on the joint model (see block.subcontact.energy).

entries.name: block.contact.energy.fric
entries.description: Get the frictional energy dissipated at a contact

entries.name: block.contact.energy.strain.comp
entries.description: Get the compressive strain energy for the contact

entries.name: block.contact.energy.strain.shear
entries.description: Get the shear strain energy at a contact

entries.name: block.contact.energy.strain.tensile
entries.description: Get the tensile strain energy at a contact

entries.name: block.contact.energy.strain.total
entries.description: Get the total strain energy at a contact

entries.name: block.contact.energy.total
entries.description: Get the sum of all components of energy associated with the contact.

entries.name: block.contact.excavated
entries.description: Returns true if either block associated with the contact is excavated. Returns false otherwise.

entries.name: block.contact.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a contact. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: block.contact.fb1
entries.description: Get face block 1 associated with the contact. Returns null if no face block exists.

entries.name: block.contact.fb2
entries.description: Get face block 2 associated with the contact. Returns null if no face block exists.

entries.description: Get the DFN fracture ID number at a contact.

entries.name: block.contact.find
entries.description: Get the block associated with the given ID

entries.name: block.contact.flowplane
entries.description: Get the flow plane associated with a contact.

entries.name: block.contact.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to block contact bcp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: block.contact.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the block contact in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: block.contact.head
entries.description: Get the first contact from the list of contacts.

entries.name: block.contact.hidden
entries.description: Returns true if either block associated with the contact is hidden. Returns false otherwise.

entries.name: block.contact.id
entries.description: Get the contact ID number.

entries.description: Get the index (offset) for the block contact

entries.name: block.contact.isgroup

entries.name: block.contact.jset
entries.description: Get the joint set ID for the contact

entries.name: block.contact.list

entries.name: block.contact.maxid

entries.name: block.contact.near
entries.description: Get the index of the contact closest to v.

entries.description: Get the index of the next contact in the main list.

entries.description: Get the x-component of the unit normal of a contact.

entries.name: block.contact.normal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the unit normal of a contact.

entries.description: Get the number of contacts in the model.

entries.name: block.contact.subcontactlist
entries.description: Get the list of all subcontacts associated with the contact

entries.name: block.contact.type
entries.description: Get the contact type (0 = null, 1 = Face-Face, 2 = Face-Edge, 3 = Face-Vertex, 4 = Edge-Edge, 5 = Edge-Vertex, 6 = Vertex- Vertex, 7 = Joined).

entries.name: block.contact.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell contact pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: block.contactlist
entries.description: Get the list of contacts for the specified block.

entries.name: block.ctol
entries.description: Get/set the contact distance tolerance. Contacts are deleted if the distance from the common plane is greater than ctol; contacts are added if block is within ctol of the common plane. The default tyolerance is 5 × atol.

entries.name: block.damp.alpha
entries.description: Get/set the value of stiffness damping constant for Rayleigh damping (alpha).

entries.name: block.damp.beta
entries.description: Get/set the value of mass damping constant for Rayleigh damping (beta).

entries.name: block.damp.global
entries.description: Get/set the auto (global) damping constant.

entries.name: block.damp.local
entries.description: Get/set the local damping constant. Default is 0.8.

entries.name: block.density
entries.description: Get/set the block density for rigid blocks.

entries.name: block.disp
entries.description: Get the displacement of a block. This is the average of gridpoint displacements.

entries.name: block.disp.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the angular velocity of a block.

entries.name: block.disp.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the angular velocity of a block.

entries.name: block.disp.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the angular velocity of a block.

entries.name: block.dsf
entries.description: Get the block density scaling factor.

entries.name: block.dtol
entries.description: Get/set the minimum edge length when cutting blocks. The default = atol.

entries.name: block.eigen
entries.description: Get the eigenmode frequency mode i for the block assembly. Used after the block dynamic eigen command.

entries.description: Get/set the

entries.name: block.excavated

entries.description: Get/set the value of the block extra variable at index 1. Use the optional argument i to affect the value of an extra variable at a different index.

entries.name: block.face.area
entries.description: Get the area of a face.

entries.name: block.face.bface
entries.description: Get the original rigid block face associated with a zone face.

entries.name: block.face.excavated
entries.description: Get the excavated status of the host block. Returns true if host block is excavated.

entries.name: block.face.extra
entries.description: Get/set the data stored in the extra variable at index i for a face. The value in an extra variable can by any valid FISH type.

entries.name: block.face.fblock
entries.description: Get the face block associated with this face. Returns null if no face block exists.

entries.name: block.face.fid
entries.description: Get the DFN fracture ID for this face

entries.name: block.face.find
entries.description: Get the frace from the input ID

entries.name: block.face.flowplane
entries.description: Get the fluid flow plane associated with this face.

entries.name: block.face.fos.kinematic
entries.description: Get the factor of safety per block face according to the “isolated block stability method.”

entries.name: block.face.fromindex
entries.description: Get the block face from the input index (offset)

entries.name: block.face.gp
entries.description: Get the index of vertex number i of a face (see block.face.ngp).

entries.name: block.face.gplist
entries.description: Get a list of gridpoints that make up this face.

entries.name: block.face.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to block face bfp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: block.face.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the block face in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: block.face.hidden
entries.description: Get the hidden state of the host block. Returns true if host block is hidden.

entries.name: block.face.hostblock
entries.description: Get the block to which a face belongs.

entries.name: block.face.id
entries.description: Get the face ID number.

entries.description: Get the index (offset) for the face. Used with xmem, imem and fmem functions.

entries.name: block.face.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the block face and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: block.face.jset
entries.description: Get the joint set ID for this face

entries.name: block.face.list
entries.description: Get the list of all triangulated block faces in the model. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement. To get original block faces before triangulation or zoning, use block.facelist.

entries.name: block.face.list.original
entries.description: Get the list of the original (untriangulated) block faces in the model.

entries.name: block.face.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any block face in the model. The next block face created will be assigned this value plus one.

entries.name: block.face.next
entries.description: Get the index of the next face on the block.

entries.name: block.face.ngp
entries.description: Get the number of vertices (gridpoints) on a face.

entries.name: block.face.normal
entries.description: Get the face normal vector.

entries.name: block.face.normal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the face normal vector.

entries.name: block.face.normal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the face normal vector.

entries.name: block.face.normal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the face normal vector.

entries.name: block.face.num
entries.description: Get the total number of block faces in the model.

entries.name: block.face.original
entries.description: Get the original block face indicator. Returns true if the block face pointer refers to an original face. Returns false for a facet of a triangulated or zoned face.

entries.name: block.face.planar
entries.description: Get the planar flag for a face. Returns true if face is planar, false otherwise.

entries.name: block.face.pos
entries.description: Get the position of a face centroid.

entries.name: block.face.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of a face centroid.

entries.name: block.face.pos.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of a face centroid.

entries.name: block.face.pos.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of a face centroid.

entries.name: block.face.sreg
entries.description: Get/set the face surface region number (deprecated - use face groups instead).

entries.name: block.face.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell block face pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: block.face.zone
entries.description: Get the index of that zone that contains the given face.

entries.name: block.facelist
entries.description: Get the list of faces for the specified block. By default, the list of block zone faces is returned. However, if the optional argument b is set false, the list of original faces for the block is returned.

entries.name: block.feb.elementlist
entries.description: Get the list of finite elements associated with the block

entries.name: block.feb.facelist
entries.description: Get the lisr of finite element faces associated with the block

entries.name: block.field.component
entries.description: Get/set the scalar value retrieved from a name that returns a vector. If the type is not a vector, this value is ignored. Valid strings are x, y, z, and magnitude.

entries.name: block.field.dist.max
entries.description: Get/set the maximum search distance used by the block.field.get functions when looking up data at a position.

entries.name: block.field.effective
entries.description: Get/set the stress to be effective (effective stress = true)

entries.name: block.field.extra
entries.description: Get/set the index used to retrieve extra variables. By default, this is 1.

entries.name: block.field.get
entries.description: Get data from the model at the location specified by v. The optional argument fdef specifies which value to return if v is not inside any zone in the model. By default, fdef = 0.0.

entries.name: block.field.get.gp
entries.description: Get data directly from the gridpoint bgpp and zone bzp. Note that one of the two values may not be required, depending on the type of data queried and the extrapolation method specified.

entries.name: block.field.hide.exc
entries.description: Get/set the indicator to skip hidden or excavated zones (skip hidden or excavated = true)

entries.name: block.field.index
entries.description: Get/set the the index number of the data type name that should be queried.

entries.name: block.field.init
entries.description: Initializes the zone field data system for the current method and the current data type. Results of calculations are stored internally where possible to minimize the calculations caused by multiple calls to block.field.get.

entries.name: block.field.method.index
entries.description: Get/set the index number of the extrapolation method used for block zone-based variables.

entries.name: block.field.method.name
entries.description: Get/set the method used for extrapolation of block zone-based variables.

entries.name: block.field.name
entries.description: Get/set the name of the value being retrieved from block zones.

entries.name: block.field.power
entries.description: Get/set the power exponent used for the inverse-distance-weighting method of extrapolation. The default is 3.0.

entries.name: block.field.prop
entries.description: Get/set the name of the property to retrieve when the block. zone.field.name has been set to property, property-fluid, or property-thermal.

entries.name: block.field.quantity
entries.description: Get/set the scalar quantity to retrieve when the value being obtained is a tensor. This value is ignored if the type is not a tensor. The available quantity names are listed in the following table.

entries.name: block.field.radius.ratio
entries.description: Get/set the the radius ratio parameter used for the inverse-distance-weighting method of extrapolation. The default is 0.75.

entries.name: block.field.reset
entries.description: Removes the effect of zone.field.init. The return value is ignored.

entries.name: block.field.source
entries.description: Get/set where values are derived from when appropriate.

entries.name: block.field.tol
entries.description: Get/set the tolerance used for the polynomial method of extrapolation. The default is 1e-7.

entries.name: block.find
entries.description: Get the pointer to the block for the input ID.

entries.name: block.fix
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block fix condition (true = fixed).

entries.name: block.fluid.bulk
entries.description: Get/set the global fluid bulk modulus

entries.name: block.fluid.cohesion
entries.description: Get/set the cohesion of fluid for non-Newtonian flow

entries.name: block.fluid.density
entries.description: Get/set the density of fluid for fluid flow.

entries.name: block.fluid.htc
entries.description: Get/set the fluid heat transfer coefficient

entries.name: block.fluid.specheat
entries.description: Get/set the fluid specific heat

entries.name: block.fluid.tension
entries.description: Get/set the minimum fluid pressure that can be supported. The default is 0. To allow negative pore pressures to develop, specify a negative number.

entries.name: block.fluid.thermcond
entries.description: Get/set the fluid thermal conductivity

entries.name: block.fluid.viscosity
entries.description: Get/set the intial, global fluid viscosity. Viscosity may change locally due to changes in proppant concentration.

entries.name: block.fluid.vol.unbal.av
entries.description: Get the average unbalanced flow volume calculated when fastflow is on.

entries.name: block.fluid.vol.unbal.max
entries.description: Get the maximum unbalanced flow volume calculated when fastflow is on.

entries.name: block.force.app
entries.description: Get/set the applied force vector (for rigid blocks only).

entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the applied force vector (for rigid blocks only).

entries.name: block.force.app.y
entries.description: Get/set the y-component of the applied force vector (for rigid blocks only).

entries.name: block.force.app.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the applied force vector (for rigid blocks only).

entries.description: Get the unbalanced force on a block.

entries.description: Get the x-component of the unbalanced force on a block.

entries.name: block.force.unbal.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the unbalanced force on a block.

entries.name: block.force.unbal.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the unbalanced force on a block.

entries.name: block.fragment.extra
entries.description: Get/set the value stored in the extra variable of the fragment at index i (1 if i is not given). This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.find
entries.description: Get the fragment with ID number i. Returns null if there is no such fragment. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to the fragment in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the fragment in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.id
entries.description: Get the fragment ID number. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the fragment and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.list
entries.description: Get the list of all fragments in the model. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called. This is primarily used in the c loop foreach statement.

entries.name: block.fragment.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum ID number assigned to any fragment in the model. The next fragment created will be assigned this value plus one. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.num
entries.description: Get the total number of fragments in the model. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.typeid
entries.description: Get an identifier that uniquely determines the type of object. It can be used with type.pointer.id to tell fragment pointers from any other type of FISH pointer. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.fragment.volume
entries.description: Get the volume of a fragment. This assumes block fragment compute has already been called.

entries.name: block.freefield

entries.description: Get the block pointer from the input index (offset)

entries.name: block.gas.constant
entries.description: Get/set the gas constant for gas flow

entries.name: block.gas.densmin
entries.description: Get/set the minimum density for gas flow

entries.name: block.gp.accel.y
entries.description: Get the y-component of the acceleration vector of the block gridpoint.

entries.name: block.gp.accel.z
entries.description: Get the z-component of the acceleration vector of the block gridpoint.

entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the boundary condition indicators.

entries.name: block.gp.dsf

entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to gridpoint bgpp in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.
